title: Vantor Color Infrared
description:
Very high resolution optical imagery from Vantor (formerly Maxar) WorldView-2/3, delivered as 8-band multispectral tiles at roughly 0.4 m ground sample distance. False colour infrared view: source bands 7 (NIR1), 5 (Red), 3 (Green) selected at render time. Healthy vegetation appears red.

This collection and its sibling deliberately discover the SAME objects under ProgramData/Vantor/Multispectral/: one 8-band UInt16 COG per tile, with the colour composite chosen at render time via bidx. Staging the raw tiles once instead of two pre-composited copies halves the footprint (~4 GB per tile) and keeps every band available. Shared discovery is intentional here and is the one exception to the no-cross-claim rule in CLAUDE.md.

Collected in response to the June 2026 Venezuela earthquake activation.

colorir.title: Color Infrared
colorir.description: False colour infrared view: source bands 7 (NIR1), 5 (Red), 3 (Green) selected at render time. Healthy vegetation appears red. Source band order is the WorldView 8-band multispectral set: 1 Coastal, 2 Blue, 3 Green, 4 Yellow, 5 Red, 6 Red Edge, 7 NIR1, 8 NIR2. The delivered files' GDAL colour-interpretation tags label bands 1/2/3 as Red/Green/Blue; that is a structural artefact (PHOTOMETRIC=RGB with five ExtraSamples) and must not be used for band selection.
